entries.name: ZYNERGY / petrelintide plus enicepatide
entries.stage: Phase 2 not yet recruiting; estimated start date has passed
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted NCT07589686 record describes a Phase 2 dose-finding study of weekly petrelintide co-administered with weekly enicepatide in adults with obesity or overweight. The study remains not yet recruiting even though its estimated 30 September 2026 start date has passed; enrolment of 486 and the January 2028 completion remain estimates.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed registry evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for the combination or either investigational regimen.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed registry evidence.
entries.supply: A not-yet-recruiting trial does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The combination is separate from both monotherapy programmes and cannot inherit either medicine's evidence or development stage. The registry has no posted results. An estimated start date is not proof of first dosing, recruitment or study initiation, and planned weight, metabolic and safety outcomes are not completed evidence.

fields.summaryToAppend: Separately, the investigator-sponsored NCT07517042 record describes a recruiting Chinese maintenance study after an actual 10 June 2026 start. It compares reduced-dose weekly mazdutide, intensive lifestyle support, their combination and standard health education after initial mazdutide-assisted weight loss.
fields.limitationsToAppend: The maintenance study has no posted results. Its 420-participant enrolment and December 2028 completion remain estimates, and it does not establish that reduced-dose mazdutide, lifestyle support or their combination maintains weight loss. China authorisation does not establish UK authorisation, NHS access or UK supply.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07517042: ASCEND-1 mazdutide maintenance study
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Automatic record-status checks; no assessment of clinical outcomes.

fields.summaryToAppend: The sponsor-submitted NCT07654374 record now shows ACCOMPLISH-2 recruiting after an actual 17 July 2026 start. The Phase 3 study evaluates oral once-daily aleniglipron in adults with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes, with 1,100 estimated participants and a week-76 body-weight endpoint.
fields.limitationsToAppend: Recruitment and an actual start are not results or completion. The registry has no posted results; September 2028 primary completion and November 2028 study completion remain estimates. The type 2 diabetes population and maintenance-dose design must not be silently generalized to every aleniglipron study or indication.

discoveryPass.included: ZYNERGY was retained in a 30 September proposal but never published. ASCEND-1 and ACCOMPLISH-2 were absent from current main and dated publication receipts. Mazdutide and aleniglipron remain existing programme entries; only the combination adds a programme.
discoveryPass.notDuplicated: The existing mazdutide China authorisation, aleniglipron monotherapy summary and petrelintide and enicepatide monotherapy entries remain separate. GitHub reported no open Medicines Watch review PRs at review time.
